headline: Bias, prejudice, discrimination · 03:36

items.title: 03:36 · Because cognitive bandwidth is finite the neural
items.detail: Because cognitive bandwidth is finite, the neural network compresses complex social variation into low-dimensional group labels long before deliberative reasoning engages.

items.title: 03:45 · That rapid pattern compression served ancestral survival
items.detail: That rapid pattern compression served ancestral survival in small bands, where distinguishing coalition partners from strangers carried immediate physical consequences.

items.title: 03:53 · On top of that shared cognitive baseline
items.detail: On top of that shared cognitive baseline, experimental psychology distinguishes three specific interpersonal constructs that govern how individuals process and act upon group categories.

items.detail: Bias operates across both explicit, consciously endorsed evaluations and implicit, automatic cognitive associations.
